name: Nepal_Tourist_Destinations_TO3
_preprocessing: Point geometry validated using QGIS Check Validity (GEOS engine). CRS: WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Choropleth attribute: annual_visitors. District polygons removed — this dataset contains tourist destination points only.

properties.name: Pashupatinath Temple
properties.description: Sacred Hindu temple on the Bagmati River, one of the holiest Shiva shrines in Asia.

properties.name: Boudhanath Stupa
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage — one of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world.

properties.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage — royal palace square at the heart of old Kathmandu.

properties.name: Swayambhunath Stupa
properties.description: Ancient hilltop complex known as the Monkey Temple, UNESCO World Heritage.

properties.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage — medieval Newar city famed for its crafts and temples.

properties.name: Patan Durbar Square
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage — finest surviving example of Newari palace architecture.

properties.name: Phewa Lake
properties.description: Pokhara's iconic lake with Machhapuchhre reflections — boating and lakeside walks.

properties.name: Manakamana Temple
properties.description: Goddess Bhagwati temple accessible by a dramatic aerial cable car.

properties.name: Lumbini Sacred Garden
properties.description: Birthplace of Lord Buddha — UNESCO World Heritage Site.

properties.name: Chitwan National Park
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage — Bengal tigers, one-horned rhinos and elephant safaris.

properties.name: Nagarkot
properties.description: Sunrise panorama over 8 Himalayan ranges — from Everest to Dhaulagiri.

properties.name: Budhanilkantha Temple
properties.description: Open-air shrine with a giant reclining Vishnu statue in a water tank.

properties.name: Sarangkot
properties.description: Iconic sunrise viewpoint over Pokhara Valley and the Annapurna massif.

properties.name: Shivapuri Nagarjun NP
properties.description: National park on Kathmandu's northern rim — forest trails and bird watching.

properties.name: Pokhara Paragliding
properties.description: World-class tandem paragliding with Annapurna panorama and Phewa Lake below.

properties.name: Changu Narayan Temple
properties.description: Oldest temple in Nepal on a forested hilltop, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

properties.name: Chandragiri Hills
properties.description: Cable car ride to 2,551 m with sweeping Kathmandu Valley and Himalayan views.

properties.name: Trishuli River Rafting
properties.description: Most accessible white-water rafting from Kathmandu — Grade III–IV rapids.

properties.name: Poon Hill
properties.description: Iconic sunrise viewpoint over Annapurna and Dhaulagiri at 3,210 m.

properties.name: Muktinath Temple
properties.description: Sacred pilgrimage site at 3,760 m revered by both Hindus and Buddhists.

properties.name: Dhulikhel
properties.description: Mountain town with spectacular Himalayan vista, a favourite weekend escape.

properties.name: Kopan Monastery
properties.description: Tibetan Buddhist monastery on the rim of the Valley offering meditation courses.

properties.name: Lukla (EBC Gateway)
properties.description: Starting point for the Everest Base Camp trek — the famous Hillary airstrip.

properties.name: Namche Bazaar
properties.description: Sherpa capital and acclimatisation hub on the classic EBC trail.

properties.name: Sagarmatha National Park
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage — Himalayan ecosystem surrounding Mount Everest.

properties.name: Begnas Lake
properties.description: Tranquil lake 15 km east of Pokhara — quieter and less touristed than Phewa.

properties.name: Annapurna Base Camp
properties.description: Classic trek through rhododendron forest and glacier to 4,130 m.

properties.name: Bandipur Village
properties.description: Perfectly preserved Newari hilltop trading village — traffic-free and timeless.

properties.name: Bandipur Viewpoint
properties.description: Panoramic view of the Marsyangdi Valley and snow peaks from the hilltop town.

properties.name: Zip Flyer Pokhara
properties.description: World's steepest zip-line — 1.8 km at up to 120 km/h over Sarangkot hill.

properties.name: Phulchoki Hill
properties.description: Highest hill surrounding the Kathmandu Valley with diverse flora and mountain views.

properties.name: Panauti
properties.description: Pristine medieval town at river confluence with intact triple-roofed temples.

properties.name: Halesi Mahadev Cave
properties.description: Sacred cave temple revered as the Pashupatinath of the Eastern Hills.

properties.name: Kakani Viewpoint
properties.description: Peaceful hilltop with panoramic Central Himalayan views, 30 km from Kathmandu.

properties.name: Kirtipur
properties.description: Ancient twin-hilltop Newar town with living Newari traditions and crafts.

properties.name: Gosaikunda Lake
properties.description: Sacred alpine lake at 4,380 m — major pilgrimage site during Janai Purnima.

properties.name: Langtang Valley Trek
properties.description: Stunning Himalayan valley, 2–3 days from Kathmandu, rich in yak-herding culture.

properties.name: Langtang National Park
properties.description: Rich high-altitude biodiversity park — red pandas, snow leopards and Himalayan tahr.

properties.name: Thimi
properties.description: Town of masks, pottery and papier-mâché — finest Newari craft traditions.

properties.name: Taudaha Lake
properties.description: Small natural lake on the Valley floor — excellent winter birdwatching spot.

properties.name: Tansen (Palpa)
properties.description: Historic hillside town famed for Dhaka weaving, metalwork and Newari heritage.

properties.name: Gokyo Lakes Trek
properties.description: Turquoise glacial lakes at 4,700–5,000 m with panorama of four 8,000 m peaks.

properties.name: Bardia National Park
properties.description: Nepal's largest Terai park — best chance to spot Bengal tigers in the wild.

properties.name: Last Resort Bungee
properties.description: 160 m bungee jump over the Bhote Koshi gorge — among Asia's highest.

properties.name: Bhote Koshi Rafting
properties.description: Thrilling Grade IV–V white-water rafting on a steep Himalayan river.

properties.name: Manaslu Circuit
properties.description: Remote circuit around 8th highest peak crossing the 5,106 m Larkya La pass.

properties.name: Koshi Tappu Reserve
properties.description: Ramsar wetland — critical habitat for migratory birds and wild water buffalo.

properties.name: Kali Gandaki Rafting
properties.description: Rafting through one of the world's deepest gorges between Annapurna and Dhaulagiri.

properties.name: Upper Mustang Trek
properties.description: Restricted-area trek to the ancient walled Kingdom of Lo Manthang.

properties.name: Rara Lake
properties.description: Nepal's largest lake at 2,990 m — pristine, remote and hauntingly beautiful.
